capability: Reliable learned attack and party-switch decisions across varied multi-turn trainer battles.
learned_authority: Existing neural heads choose moves, attack versus switch, and replacements. No referee, lookup table or teacher substitutes actions during evaluation.
transfer_test: Freeze each candidate before prospective unused scenario comparisons; retain natural encounter ancestry and require independent-origin evidence for broader readiness. No consumed DEVELOPMENT replay or training.
cheapest_falsifier: Inspect stalled attack-gradient constraints and observed TRAIN coverage without fitting or launching a ROM.
time_box: Two hours before mandatory reassessment; proceed through diagnosis, justified bounded learning and qualification rather than stopping at another review.
stop_condition: Stop a declared candidate on its frozen failure rules. Retain diagnostics before deciding whether a distinct successor is justified; no blind hyperparameter sweep, weakened retention limits, full-game run or publication.
readiness_scope: Attack and switching segment only; unsupported status/recovery/boost, Counter, self-destruct and all-party Struggle remain explicit exclusions.
initial_action: Read-only existing TRAIN audit completed: one binding protected attack was worse by 0.1005979682 measured return, and finite projection left a linearized violation. Terminal128 covers only five active species, all level32.

bounded_successor.loss: equal group weight old52 and terminal128 measured expected regret
bounded_successor.checkpoint_selection: Only numeric-budget-feasible TRAIN checkpoints; minimize terminal selected-action regret, then terminal expected regret, then earliest epoch. Intermediate iterates are never deployed.
